fields.title: Data is kept for as long as somebody needs it

sections.Purpose: We keep a record for as long as somebody needs it, and we delete it once nobody does. A store nobody prunes grows into a liability at the same rate it grows in size.
sections.Scope: Every store we operate, whatever holds it.
sections.Exceptions: A store under a legal hold outlives its retention period. We record the hold against the store, and the period resumes on the day the hold lifts.
